headline: Trump declares Iran ceasefire 'is over', calls Tehran 'scum'
summary: US President Donald Trump has ended the interim ceasefire agreement with Iran, revoking oil sale licenses following failed talks in Qatar.
details: US President Donald Trump announced on Wednesday that the memorandum of understanding signed with Iran to end their conflict is now over. He stated that he no longer wishes to engage with Tehran, calling the Iranian leadership 'scum' and 'sick people'.

The interim ceasefire, mediated by Pakistan, was meant to provide a 60-day window for negotiations on a permanent agreement. However, indirect talks held in Qatar ended last week without any progress.
Following the collapse of talks, the US military launched a new wave of strikes against Iran on Tuesday.

In a further escalation, the US has revoked a license that allowed Iran to sell crude oil and petrochemical products. This move follows reports that three tankers were hit by projectiles in the Strait of Hormuz.
The revoked license, originally issued by the US Treasury on June 22, had allowed sales through August 21. Iran has now been given until July 17 to wind down all remaining transactions.
caption:
Trump ends the Iran ceasefire, calling the leadership 'scum' and 'sick people' after failed talks.

US President Donald Trump announced on Wednesday that the memorandum of understanding signed with Iran to end their conflict is now over. He stated that he no longer wishes to engage with Tehran, calling the Iranian leadership 'scum' and 'sick people'.

The interim ceasefire, mediated by Pakistan, was meant to provide a 60-day window for negotiations on a permanent agreement. However, indirect talks held in Qatar ended last week without any progress.

Following the collapse of talks, the US military launched a new wave of strikes against Iran on Tuesday.

In a further escalation, the US has revoked a license that allowed Iran to sell crude oil and petrochemical products. This move follows reports that three tankers were hit by projectiles in the Strait of Hormuz.

The revoked license, originally issued by the US Treasury on June 22, had allowed sales through August 21. Iran has now been given until July 17 to wind down all remaining transactions.

headline_marked: Schoolgirl [[calls teacher 'Abbu' on exam paper]] to ask for marks
headline: Schoolgirl calls teacher 'Abbu' on exam paper to ask for marks
summary: A 7th-grade student wrote a heartfelt note to her teacher on her answer script, calling him 'father' to persuade him to give her more marks.
details: A 7th-grade student has gained attention after writing a personal plea to her teacher on her exam paper.
The student wrote that she ran out of time and could not finish writing all the answers in the clean copy of the script.
In a desperate attempt to secure better marks, she addressed the teacher as 'Abbu' (father), pleading for his kindness.
The note includes repeated calls of 'Abbu, Abbu, Abbu,' asking the teacher to give her a few marks.
The incident has sparked amusement and social media discussion about the students' creative ways of seeking marks.
caption:
Would you call your teacher 'Dad' to get better grades? This 7th grader did!

A 7th-grade student has gained attention after writing a personal plea to her teacher on her exam paper.

The student wrote that she ran out of time and could not finish writing all the answers in the clean copy of the script.

In a desperate attempt to secure better marks, she addressed the teacher as 'Abbu' (father), pleading for his kindness.

The note includes repeated calls of 'Abbu, Abbu, Abbu,' asking the teacher to give her a few marks.

The incident has sparked amusement and social media discussion about the students' creative ways of seeking marks.
